# BrandStruck

> > BrandStruck provides in-depth brand strategy and positioning case studies across major global brands, analyzing brand archetypes, positioning frameworks, and strategic insights.

Founded by brand strategist Magda Adamska, BrandStruck examines how leading brands across industries—from Coca-Cola and L'Oréal to Audi and PayPal—develop and execute their brand positioning strategies. The site focuses on practical case study analysis using frameworks like brand archetypes (Ruler, Hero, Outlaw) and positioning methodologies.

## Key Topics

- Brand Positioning
